thought.text: Clean state with consistent ports. Now the single `just serve` for all three (fully cached builds):

reasoning_content: The nginx and ports.json are now synced (39001/39002/39003), and all ports are open. Next is a single `just serve` for all 3 — with builds fully cached this time (each build should complete in about 1–2 minutes), and thanks to the file cache it should fit in memory.

action.command:
cd /workspace
export GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_dummytesttoken0000000000000000000000"
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
rm -f /tmp/final-serve.log
setsid nohup bash -c 'exec just serve < /dev/zero' > /tmp/final-serve.log 2>&1 &
echo "serve pid $!"
sleep 20; tail -2 /tmp/final-serve.log
